title: 第8章 八卦龙腾扳指第9章 师傅是土豪
content_zh:
第一卷 重生归来 第八章 八卦龙腾扳指
苏芮跟着柳青云进入书房，看到古朴的书架上放着满满的古籍，面上不露，心中却惊讶非常。
柳青云从一个暗格中拿出一个木盒，盒子上面雕刻着一个盘龙，虽然不是真正的龙，但还是让人觉得威武霸气。那一双龙目，好像一直注视着你，让人不由自主的臣服。龙的嘴里，衔着一个八卦镜，让苏芮觉得很奇怪，但是又觉得异常的和谐。
毕竟是活过一世的人了，苏芮很快就回过神来，看向了柳青云。
柳青云看到苏芮能在这么短的时间内清醒，感到很欣慰，要知道当初他可是足足呆愣了一个钟头才被师傅叫醒的。
柳青云在盒子上轻轻按了几下，盒子就自动弹开了，只见里面放着一本线装书，还有一个白玉扳指。
感受到苏芮疑惑的目光，柳青云拿起白玉扳指递给了苏芮。
苏芮接过扳指，发现扳指上也雕刻着一条衔着八卦镜的龙，只不过这条龙是缠绕在扳指上的，而且眼睛也是闭着的。
随后苏芮放下扳指，拿起了那本线装书。
那本书，看着很厚，但事实上
苏芮看向柳青云，柳青云这才开口，“这本书和那个扳指是本门的传承之物。书我也不知道是干什么用的，也不是因为不认识上面的字，而是真的看不懂。而这个扳指，是门主信物，每一任的门主在接任的时候都要滴血认主，让它承认你的气息，而没被承认的人拿到了这个扳指也会七窍流血而死。”
“那假如有人偷了这个扳指，自己滴血认主了怎么办，那不就成他的啦。”苏芮疑惑的看着柳青云。
“你这个丫头，不是告诉过你，天玑门的弟子都是由天道承认的，没被天道承认的人怎么可能让扳指滴血认主。你以为别人拿到扳指为什么会七窍流血而死，那是天道对他的惩罚！”柳青云气急败坏说。
苏芮吐了吐舌头，陪笑道“师傅，我这不是有问题就要问嘛，好孩子都应该这样，是吧~”
“别说没用的，快些滴血认主。”说罢，不知从哪拿出一根针来。
苏芮只能闭着眼睛在手指上扎了一个小孔，血一碰到扳指就被它疯狂的吸收了。
苏芮看到，下了一跳。用力甩着手。“师傅师傅，它会不会把我的血吸干啊，快拿开它啊，我甩也甩不掉。”
“怕什么，你以为就那一丢丢血就能让扳指认主啊。怎么着也得一茶杯的血啊。”柳青云给了苏芮一个你少见多怪的眼神。
苏芮幽怨的看着柳青云，心想，我这刚拜师呢，你啥都没教我，就让我出一杯子血。真是太吃亏了！
过了一刻钟，那扳指还粘在苏芮的手指上。现在就连柳青云也觉得奇怪了。

不应该啊，怎么会需要这么多血，柳青云看着这个扳指，突然大叫“啊！居然是这样！天佑我天玑门啊，哈哈哈哈~”
苏芮愤愤看着这个便宜师傅，我这还留着血呢，你高兴什么，时间长点我就要被吸成干尸了！
“咳咳，你不会变成干尸的，过一会等扳指吸够了就会停止的。”柳青云尴尬的说。原来，苏芮不知不觉把心里话说出来了。这下她无地自容了。
“你先看看这个扳指，与之前有什么不同？”
苏芮低下头，看扳指，“它的眼睛，龙的眼睛竟然睁开了，天啊，太神奇了！”
苏芮猛地抬起头，看向柳青云，眼睛睁的大大的，晶晶亮。好像在说，师傅快告诉我吧。
看过了大人一样的苏芮，当她露出这么可爱的表情，柳青云噗嗤一声笑了出来。
这下苏芮闹了一个大红脸。低下头，撇撇嘴。
柳青云看这宝贝徒弟在逗下去就要恼羞成怒了，遂正了正颜色，开口道“你刚拜师还不知道，我们天玑门是由祖师天玑子创立的，这八卦腾龙扳指和八卦盘龙集是祖师之物，而这八卦腾龙扳指更是常伴祖师之物，所以这个扳指也是天玑门的门主信物。而这八卦腾龙扳指上的神龙迄今为止只有在祖师手中时是睁开眼睛的，而你，则是第二个让龙睁开眼睛的人。所以你就是复兴我天玑门的有缘人。”
苏芮看着神情激动的柳青云，疑惑道“那你怎么知道我就是那个有缘人，天道告诉你的？天道怎么说的？”
“我师父仙去时告诉我，向西走，走到不想走之后，就在那等待，与有缘人自会相见。”
说罢，柳青云盯着苏芮的脸，“你要知道，我天玑门最大的能力就是能预测未来，而我看不透你的未来。所以你就是我天玑门的有缘人啊。”
看透未来！饶是淡定的苏芮也瞪大眼睛，露出不可置信的表情。世上真的有人可以看透未来么。这是多么逆天的能力啊。
“你也不用惊讶，以后你也会有这个能力的。不过天玑门已然衰败。我也只能看到未来一些重大事件而已。”柳青云，惆怅的叹了一口气。看向苏芮，眼中又充满火热。
“干…干嘛这样看着我啊，我知道我是那个有缘人，现在我已经拜入天玑门下了。天玑门的事自然也是我的事了。谁让整个门派就咱们两个人，我不做难道让你一个老头子做啊”苏芮撇撇嘴，对着柳青云翻了个白眼。
－－－－－－题外话－－－－－－

Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 8: The Eight Diagrams Dragon Teng Teng
Su Rui followed Liu Qingyun into the study room and saw the quaint bookshelves full of ancient books. She didn't show any signs of it on her face, but she was very surprised in her heart.
Liu Qingyun took out a wooden box from a hidden compartment. There was a dragon carved on the box. Although it was not a real dragon, it still made people feel powerful and domineering. Those pair of dragon eyes seem to be watching you all the time, making people surrender involuntarily. There was a Bagua mirror in the dragon's mouth, which made Su Rui feel strange, but at the same time it felt unusually harmonious.
After all, he was a person who had lived a lifetime. Su Rui quickly came to her senses and looked at Liu Qingyun.
Liu Qingyun felt very relieved to see Su Rui wake up in such a short period of time. He must have known that he had been stunned for a full hour before being woken up by his master.
Liu Qingyun pressed the box lightly a few times, and the box popped open automatically, revealing a thread-bound book and a white jade finger ring inside.
Feeling Su Rui's doubtful gaze, Liu Qingyun picked up the white jade ring and handed it to Su Rui.
Su Rui took the wrench and found that it was also carved with a dragon holding a Bagua Mirror in its mouth, but this dragon was wrapped around the wrench and its eyes were closed.
Then Su Rui put down her thumb and picked up the thread-bound book.
That book looks very thick, but in fact
Su Rui looked at Liu Qingyun, and then Liu Qingyun said, "This book and the ring finger are the inheritance of this sect. I don't know what the book is used for, and it's not because I don't know the words on it, but I really can't understand it. And this ring finger is a token of the sect leader. When taking over, every sect leader must shed blood to recognize the master, so that he can recognize your aura, and those who are not recognized will bleed to death if they get this ring finger."
"Then what if someone steals this ring and claims it with his own blood? Then it becomes his." Su Rui looked at Liu Qingyun doubtfully.
"You girl, didn't I tell you that the disciples of the Tianji Sect are all recognized by Heaven? How can someone who is not recognized by Heaven be allowed to recognize their master with blood dripping from his finger? Why do you think someone bleeds to death after getting a finger? That is Heaven's punishment for him!" Liu Qingyun said angrily.
Su Rui stuck out her tongue and said with a smile, "Master, if I have any questions, I have to ask them. This is what good children should do, right~"
"Don't say it's useless. Quickly shed blood to identify the master." After saying that, he took out a needle from nowhere.
Su Rui could only close her eyes and prick a small hole in her finger. The blood was absorbed crazily as soon as it touched the finger.
Su Rui jumped when she saw it. Shake your hands vigorously. "Master, master, will it suck my blood dry? Get it away quickly. I can't shake it off."
"What are you afraid of? Do you think that just a drop of blood can make Wan Zhi identify his master? No matter what, he still needs a teacup of blood." Liu Qingyun gave Su Rui a strange look that you rarely see.
Su Rui looked at Liu Qingyun resentfully, thinking, I just became a disciple, and you didn't teach me anything, just asked me to bleed a cup of blood. What a loss!
A quarter of an hour later, the ring finger was still stuck to Su Rui's finger. Even Liu Qingyun feels strange now.
It shouldn't be, why does it need so much blood? Liu Qingyun looked at this finger and suddenly shouted, "Ah! It's like this! God bless my Tianji Sect, hahahaha~"
Su Rui looked at this cheap master angrily, "I still have blood here, what are you happy about? If it takes a long time, I will be sucked into a mummy!"
"Ahem, you won't turn into a mummy. You will stop after a while when the finger has sucked enough." Liu Qingyun said awkwardly. It turned out that Su Rui had unknowingly spoken out what was on her mind. Now she felt ashamed.
"Take a look at this ring first. How is it different from before?"
Su Rui lowered her head and looked at the ring, "Its eyes, the dragon's eyes actually opened. Oh my god, it's amazing!"
Su Rui suddenly raised her head and looked at Liu Qingyun, her eyes wide open.Big and shiny. It seems to be saying, master, tell me quickly.
After seeing Su Rui who looked like an adult, Liu Qingyun burst into laughter when she showed such a cute expression.
Su Rui suddenly blushed. He lowered his head and curled his lips.
Liu Qingyun saw that this precious apprentice was about to become angry if he continued teasing him, so he straightened his tone and said, "You have just become a disciple and you don't know yet. Our Tianji Sect was founded by the founder Tianjizi. The Bagua Tenglong Finger Pull and the Bagua Panlong Set are the ancestor's possessions, and the Bagua Tenglong Finger Pull is even more common." It is a gift from the Patriarch, so this ring is also a token of the Tianji Sect. The dragon on the Bagua Tenglong Ring has only opened its eyes when it was in the hands of the Patriarch, and you are the second person to make the dragon open its eyes. "
Su Rui looked at the excited Liu Qingyun and asked doubtfully, "Then how do you know that I am the destined person? Heaven told you? What did Heaven say?"
"When my master passed away, he told me to go west. When you get to the point where you don't want to leave, just wait there and you will meet the person you are destined to meet."
After saying that, Liu Qingyun stared at Su Rui's face, "You have to know that the greatest ability of our Tianji Sect is to predict the future, but I can't see through your future. So you are the destined person of my Tianji Sect."
See through the future! Even the calm Su Rui opened her eyes wide with an expression of disbelief. Is there really anyone in the world who can see through the future? What an incredible ability this is.
"Don't be surprised, you will also have this ability in the future. However, Tianji Sect has declined. I can only see some major events in the future." Liu Qingyun sighed melancholy. Looking at Su Rui, her eyes were full of fire again.
"Why...why are you looking at me like this? I know that I am the one who is destined to be a disciple. Now I have become a disciple of Tianji Sect. The affairs of Tianji Sect are naturally my business. Who makes the whole sect just the two of us? If I don't do it, why should you, an old man, do it?" Su Rui curled her lips and rolled her eyes at Liu Qingyun.
